Maybe it's exactly what we need after today. True. And don't forget, we promised to watch that DIY show this week. I want to tackle that backyard project and I'll need your guidance. Of course. I love how dedicated you are to improving our garden. I'll make sure to set aside some time for that. I just hope we don't have another week like this one with delays and setbacks. This past week seemed to drag on. Week's been tough but we've made it through. Tomorrow's a new day! Indeed. And I’m just glad to be able to share this quiet evening with you.

Oh, did I sound so awful on that phone call to your parents? I swear, when people around here are speaking clearly, I don't notice much of a difference. But when I've got a cold... No, you were fine. Just kind of... far away. It kind of makes me want to visit your hometown though, and see the real accent out in the wild. Oh, please don't. You'll get me sounding like a proper Lancashire lass out of keeps coming backwards. Anyway, how are you feeling? You okay after your sickness? Much better, thank you for asking. It just had to come at a very inconvenient time. Sorry to hear that, but that's life, isn't it? By the way, how's that new job going? It's going well, I'd say. Teaching's... not my forever thing, but it seems to suit me for now. And you? How's the TEFL going? Well, that's the thing. It's... sporadic. But when it is, it's actually quite rewarding. However, it's made me think a lot about where "home" is. Where do you feel like you belong? For me, right now, home is here, in Tarnow. It feels strange to say, but after so many winters here, the cold and snow aren't as harsh as they were at first. And the flat can sometimes feel like... really home. But sometimes when I'm scrolling through social media and see pictures from Bury. Yeah, that feeling. It's like the nagging sense of not quite being where you'd like to be. Did you consider therapy or something to work through that? Yeah, I was just thinking about it. The idea of belonging isn't just about a place, is it? It's about feeling at home with yourself, regardless of where you are. But, you know, when I look at those pictures from Bury, it's like... they’re snapshots of who I used to be, somewhere I used to fit. Makes you think. I went through something similar when I was laid off last year. It sent me into a bit of a turmoil. Did some online therapy. Wasn't as bad as I thought it'd be. But yeah, the whole "who am I if I'm not my job?" thing. It's weird how much society ties us to our work.

So tell me about your new project. I heard you've started coordinating online surveys for your university. Oh yeah, it's been keeping me busy. It's mostly just setting up various questions but I need to make sure it's all user-friendly because these people aren't tech savvy. That’s so smart of you to think about accessibility, you know how easy it is to forget that not everyone catches on to new tech quickly right? Exactly! I set up a pilot run yesterday and it was great to see it actually working as intended. Did you have a lot of coding to do for it? I used this framework they've been using on SurveyMonkey and it already has most of what we needed. It was more about inserting our specific questions and making sure the user experience was smooth. Ah SurveyMonkey! I did project with that during my graduate studies. It’s such a powerful tool. Right? And now I get to use it for actual studies, it's really fulfilling. Plus, I’m learning a lot about how people interact with forms this way it might be useful for my writing work too. That perspective could be really valuable. I deal with user experience in my copywriting. It’s all about making sure the message is clear, right? Well, technology-wise it's about giving the user the right instructions and prompts so they feel confident filling it out. But isn’t in writing, it's about making sure your key messages stand out, and the language is simple yet compelling? Exactly, and I find that's where the real creativity is – how to say something simply but powerfully. We should actually grab some food before it gets less civilized here, this pub has amazing sandwiches and cakes, they always make my afternoon. If you think they will have any by the time we get to it, I could do with some lunch. While you’re at it, get something that isn’t on my usual diet. I’m on this new kick where I’m trying not to eat processed food. Absolutely. I’ll take something so we can share. I might get the veggie seitan roll, it's one of their specials. That sounds amazing. I just read an article about how they make those things these days. I’ll have some greens with it, maybe a side salad if they have one that’s not too dressed.

Right okay so I'm going to wake up Helena and possibly Nic's Dad. Oh what's going on today? It's a bit of a book day but then we're heading into Cambridge later for the Neon Moon event. What’s that? Helena, how would you like to start your day once we've all woken up? Can we have pancakes? Pancakes?! Oh, I’ve always wanted to learn how to unicycle. I saw once in Australia how people can just ride around effortlessly. That is really cool, but unicycles can be quite tricky. You just need to set aside some dedicated practice time. I want to try once we get to the event. Maybe there are classes. If they have any workshops or demos, we should definitely check it out. Guys, while we’re planning our fun for the day, don’t forget that we need to be at the booth ready to help out by 1:30.
